name: bedrock-bench
description: Benchmark agents on real tasks; browse saved runs, replay tools, and explore success, time, and cost with contextual chat follow-ups.

interface.longDescription: Run AWS CDK repair tasks, Terminal-Bench, SWE-bench, AWS-Bench, and starter benchmarks from chat. Browse a searchable library of saved runs, compare matching results, and replay recorded Harbor/Codex tools. Ask for charts or diagrams and follow contextual next-step prompts, with cost coverage and pricing provenance retained.
defaultPrompt: Run the AWS CDK reference smoke test.
Plan a Terminal-Bench model comparison on Bedrock.
Show the offline Bedrock Bench demonstration.
Browse my recent benchmark runs and replay the latest live run.
Plot cost versus success for my saved benchmark results.
